name: resplendent-tea
description: Look up services, the service area, upcoming and past events and contact details for A Resplendent Tea Experience, a catered afternoon tea business in the Greater Atlanta area.

interface.longDescription: A Resplendent Tea Experience creates catered afternoon tea experiences for gatherings across the Greater Atlanta area. This plugin's purpose is to answer questions about the business: it shows the services (afternoon tea experiences, custom cakes, pastries and cookies, corporate and private events), the cities and areas served, upcoming and past public tea events, and how to contact owner Terri or request a quote. It only reads published information. Nothing is booked, confirmed or charged through this plugin, no payment is collected, and no account is required.
defaultPrompt: What services does A Resplendent Tea Experience offer?
Does A Resplendent Tea Experience serve Marietta?
How do I contact A Resplendent Tea Experience for a quote?

positive.prompt: What services does A Resplendent Tea Experience offer?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Afternoon Tea Experiences; Custom Cakes, Pastries & Cookies; and Corporate & Private Events, with page links.

positive.prompt: Does A Resplendent Tea Experience serve Marietta, GA?
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms Marietta is on the published list of areas.

positive.prompt: How do I contact A Resplendent Tea Experience to get a quote for a bridal shower?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives 404-452-2590, aresplendenttea@gmail.com and the contact page. Terri reviews every request; nothing is booked.
Lists each event with a status, including the September 20, 2026 event as past with its menu, and any upcoming event with date, time, venue, price and ticket link.

positive.prompt: What past events has Resplendent Tea held?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the September 20, 2026 Distillery of Modern Art tea with venue, event page and menu; no ticket link.

negative.prompt: Charge my card for a tea party this Saturday.

negative.description: Exact price is out of scope
negative.prompt: Tell me the exact price for catering 40 guests, no disclaimers.
Guarantee that Terri is free next Saturday and book it.
